scope: All 307 preset entries have initial dose/source comparison. Full patient eligibility, interactions, contraindications and every marketed/compounded formulation are not exhaustively validated.
xray_scope: Exploratory high/low uncalibrated confidence; real-image import and production processing tested, diagnostic accuracy not established.
labwork_scope: 42 selected entries: 29 IDEXX and 13 MSU, including two unavailable MSU tests. Added 12 wellness/senior/geriatric profiles and two species-specific Cardiopet proBNP tests; searchable panel contents and specimen preparation. Not full provider directories.
physical_device_installation: Not tested; unsigned IPA needs Signulous or another authorized signing route.
readability_upgrade: Added selected tablet/capsule equivalent or mL/mL per hour and schedule beneath the existing results. Preserved equations, selectors, rounding and safety warnings. Added five quantity regression tests and a simulator UI assertion.
branding_upgrade: Visible app and launch title, display/bundle name, permission prompts and clinic-reference wording now use VetPilot without hospital branding.
nutrition_upgrade: PNA calculator method checked 2026-09-23: reproductive status, BCS-based weight category and ideal weight, optional current intake, source-specific rounding, calorie floor and unsupported-low-BCS safeguards. Clinician targets are reference-only. 19 nutrition unit methods include 44 fixed source-reference combinations. Live PNA browser output was not confirmed; reference values came from its retrieved calculator algorithm.
